text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: August. Even as the summer training camp reaches its peak—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was at the airport with Cheval Grand.
...To see off Shine Praise,
who was departing for Australia.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Well then.
Have a safe trip, Shine.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...It's a promise, Cheval-chan.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"Let's both get stronger and meet at the Japan Cup.
...We're definitely running together, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a temporary farewell between childhood friends who had walked the same path together.
Thinking they should be left alone, I stepped away from the scene.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
choice_data_list: Were you able to see them off properly?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes... properly, without crying.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, th-that's obvious, isn't it?
Shine's the one who has it rough from here on out, so I can't be crying—
choice_data_list: I think it's okay to cry if you're feeling lonely.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm fine.
Because... I made a promise.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
S-So... instead of wasting time crying,
I have to train so hard I'll never lose.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because when I see Shine next time...
I don't want to look uncool.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright.
Umm—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(The Japan Cup...
The rivals we need to keep an eye on are—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Th-There are so many of them. Compared to me,
they all seem so strong, but...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh, no, that's not it!
...The one I really need to mark first
is—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...I knew it, those two.
Kita-san and Crown-san.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Kita-san really pushed herself hard again today...
I felt it back at the Tenno Sho (Spring) too, but
her stamina really is monstrous.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (And on top of that... she's truly a hard worker. Summer camp is tough, so a lot of girls want to rest partway through, but—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Kita-san seems completely fine.
At her core... she must just have an amazingly sturdy body.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(She's trained so hard and turned it all into true strength.
That's the Kita-san... I'll be facing.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(And then... as expected, Crown-san.
She's just... so bottomless.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how cornered she is, or how bad the odds are,
I've never once seen Crown-san look like she's giving up.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Those sharp eyes... are always watching for a chance.
A chance to flip the entire battlefield like a magic trick
and seize a brilliant victory.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(As a daughter of the Satono family, her eyes are set on the world stage.
And she's someone... I have to face in battle too.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... that's right.
In the Japan Cup, there's also—)
Brrrrillante...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that effort, that dedication...
It is truly dazzling, Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
However, my lovely little Bellet,
staying up too late isn't good for your health.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Can't sleep? Then why not come into my bed?
I'll envelop you in a melting lullaby—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, n-no... I'm okay. I'm totally fine...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...Sounds of Earth-san. She's running in the Japan Cup, too.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(She's got quite an unusual track record, so...
there's a lot about her I don't really get.
...But there's no doubt she's the real deal.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, I shouldn't just focus on the future...
I can't just be thinking about the Japan Cup all the time.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Because in the Kyoto Daishoten—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Phew...!
...You're closing in on me day by day, you know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can't stay Kura-chan's little sidekick forever, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I want to become a legendary Umamusume worthy of the Satono name, too...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll do great in the autumn season too,
and definitely become an Umamusume
worthy of the title 'Treasure'!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
First, we start by winning
our first post-summer race, the Kyoto Daishoten...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Dia-san... You're so well-prepared, it's hard to believe you're debuting after me.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(She's got immense talent. A strong will.
And above all else... she has pride.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (She has a different kind of strength from me—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer...!
I... I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
There's... something I want to do.
About my training.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Uh, um—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Last year... I learned that
by truly facing someone else's strength,
I could become stronger too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"That's why.
I thought... that would be the best way for the current me to become even stronger."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I need to face it... e-even more.
I have the strength to face it head-on."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I believe there is.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: The truth is, it was there... all along.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...I'd like to ask you to set up
a joint training session.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A joint training session to face the strength of others.
The partner Cheval Grand designated was—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Cheva-chi~~~!!
Trainer-san too, over here, over here!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Good morning.
...I look forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Oh, ...Good morning.
...Looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand mumbled those words briefly.
As for the look on her face...
Honestly, she looks like she's having a rough time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, that was—understandable. After all, the two of them, Vivlos and Verxina, are essentially the root of her complex.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Facing it head-on might open old wounds
and cause hearts to ache.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Even so.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I... I—
About those two—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I'm bad at dealing with her. Standing in front of her makes me feel smaller and smaller... That's the kind of opponent she is. ...Still.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I think they're... incredible Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"If you want to get stronger... you have to face the truth.
That they really are... incredible Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... have to get stronger.
I want to. Much more than I am right now.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"That's why...
I w-wanted to ask both of you... to lend me your strength."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Whaaat?! Geez, Cheval-chi!!
Of course it's totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, what should we start with?!
This is gonna be so fun, Big Sis!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Vivlos.
...Are you really sure you want us as your opponents?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You're sticking to the mid-to-long distance path this autumn, right?
Unlike you, neither Vivlos nor I have much aptitude for longer distances, you see.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...But those two have so much
that I don't."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about finding my own strength
through my sisters.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"This time... I want to face what I'm lacking.
And face the parts of me that can still grow."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, after all...
it has to be the two of us."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The speed and skill Big sis honed.
Vivlos's natural flair and boldness.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Because it's full of things I don't have.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Everything I had envied for so long—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-But!
Now, I can.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... I can face it.
Because I believe... I can use it to grow.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I've had... kind of a bad attitude about things, and I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Joint training... I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
Shall we get started right away?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No holding back now.
Big sis is going to be strict, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Uhyaa! Big Sis is in full Queen mode!
Ahaha, better hide behind Cheval-chi♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Wait, hold on, Vivlos...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The lively voices of the three sisters echo across the summer sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the upcoming Kyoto Daishoten,
and the promised Japan Cup aheadâ
our spirits rose even higher.
